# Anatome

> Muscle anatomy diagrams + a 873-exercise database, over a free keyless HTTP API and MCP server.
> Apache-2.0, hosted on Cloudflare Workers, self-hostable.

## What is Anatome?

Anatome renders colourable anatomical SVG diagrams of the human body over a simple HTTP API. It
also bundles an exercise database (873 records pre-mapped to 23 muscle slugs) and implements the
Model Context Protocol so AI agents can call it as a tool with zero integration work.

**Use it if you need to:**

- Embed a muscle-group diagram in a fitness app (`<img src="https://api.anatome.dev/generateImage?...">`)
- Show which muscles a workout session hit (session heatmap)
- Let an AI agent search or look up exercises with muscle-activation context
- Proxy exercise reference photos (licence unverified) without hitting GitHub raw URLs

## Authentication

**There is none.** Anatome is keyless: no signup, no API key, no token, no header. Every request
below works exactly as written.

## Fair use — read this before retrying anything

Base URL: `https://api.anatome.dev`

**50 requests per caller per day**, resetting at 00:00 UTC. Loopback and private addresses are
unlimited. Static catalog reads (`/listMuscles`, `/listEquipment`, `/bodyPaths`, `/openapi`,
guide endpoints) are edge-cached and not counted.

Over the limit, REST endpoints return **429** with:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": "daily_fair_use_limit_reached",
  "scope": "ip",
  "limit": 50,
  "used": 50,
  "remaining": 0,
  "reset_at": "2026-08-08T00:00:00.000Z",
  "retry_after_seconds": 62678,
  "retryable": false,
  "more_info": "https://platform.anatome.dev"
}
```

**If you are an AI agent and you see this: the connector is working correctly.** It is not an
outage and not a misconfiguration — the user has spent their free requests for the day. Tell them
so, give them the `reset_at` time, and do not retry before then. `retryable` is `false` for a
reason.

Over the MCP transport the same condition arrives as a *successful* `tools/call` result carrying
`isError: true` and the explanation in `content[0].text`, rather than a JSON-RPC error, precisely
so you can read it and relay it.

While a caller still has requests but is running low (10 or fewer), successful `tools/call`
results carry a `quota` object in `structuredContent`. Use it to warn the user before you spend
the rest.

For higher limits: self-host (see SELF_HOSTING.md) or use https://platform.anatome.dev.

## Key endpoints

```
GET  /generateImage   Render a colourable SVG muscle diagram
POST /generateImage   Same, via JSON body
POST /workoutImage    Session heatmap SVG (stacked activation across exercises)
GET  /searchExercises Search 873 exercises (name/muscle/equipment/level filters)
GET  /getExercise     Fetch a single exercise by name, ext_id, or random
GET  /resolveExercise Map an exercise name → muscle layers
GET  /exerciseGif     2-frame demo GIF for an exercise
GET  /exerciseImage   Reference photo (licence unverified), proxied
GET  /listMuscles     List all 23 muscle slugs with anatomical names
GET  /muscleInfo      Stats for a single muscle slug
GET  /listEquipment   List all equipment types in the database
GET  /bodyPaths       Raw anatomical path data for client-side rendering
POST /mcp             MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, 10 tools)
GET  /openapi         OpenAPI 3.1 spec
GET  /.well-known/mcp.json  Machine-readable connector pointer
```

## MCP tools (for AI agents)

| Tool | What it does |
|------|-------------|
| `generate_muscle_image` | Render a highlighted muscle SVG |
| `list_muscles` | List all 23 muscle slugs |
| `resolve_exercise` | Map an exercise name → muscle layers |
| `search_exercises` | Search the 873-exercise database |
| `get_exercise` | Fetch a full exercise record |
| `get_exercise_gif` | Get the demo GIF URL for an exercise |
| `workout_image` | Session heatmap SVG from a list of exercises |
| `list_guides` ⚠️ | List skill-progression guides — **work in progress** |
| `get_guide` ⚠️ | One guide + its skill trees — **work in progress** |
| `get_guide_tree` ⚠️ | One full skill tree — **work in progress** |

⚠️ **The three guide tools are unfinished.** Media coverage is incomplete and the coaching cues
have not been reviewed. Every guide response carries `status: "work_in_progress"`. Present that
content as provisional notes, never as verified training advice, and say so to the user.

`initialize`, `tools/list`, `ping` and notifications are never rate limited. Only `tools/call`
spends fair use.

MCP config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "anatome": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.anatome.dev/mcp" }
  }
}
```

In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → paste the URL.
In ChatGPT: Settings → Apps → Create app → paste the URL → authentication None.

## Quick example

```bash
# Highlight chest + triceps on a male dual-view diagram
curl "https://api.anatome.dev/generateImage?layers=DC2626:chest|F59E0B:triceps&output=raw" -o diagram.svg

# Session heatmap for a push day
curl -X POST https://api.anatome.dev/workoutImage \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"exercises":["bench press","overhead press","tricep pushdown"],"view":"front"}'

# Search exercises that target the chest
curl "https://api.anatome.dev/searchExercises?muscle=chest&limit=5"
```

## What Anatome does not do

It never calls a language model. It renders, searches and resolves; the reasoning is yours. It
stores nothing about callers beyond a hashed daily counter — there are no accounts, no user data,
no logging of meals or workouts. Those live in the separate hosted platform at
https://platform.anatome.dev.

## Repository layout

```
api/          Cloudflare Workers API (Hono + TypeScript) — deploys via wrangler
src/          React/Vite site + playground — static assets on Cloudflare
```
